title: scale_study.py CLI with [100k,1M,10M,50M] volumes writing to scale_runs
description: New etl4/bench/scale_study.py that samples the real bronze state-vector tree at the four volumes, runs the three reconstruction methods under instrumentation (perf_counter + psutil peak RSS), inserts one row per cell into Postgres scale_runs. Honours PO condition: for (kinematic_smoothing, 50M) linearly extrapolate peak_rss_mb from the prior smoothing row; if > 12000 MB, insert a NULL row with notes='skipped: projected_peak_rss_mb>12000' and skip the cell.
acceptance_criteria: python -c 'import ast; ast.parse(open("etl4/bench/scale_study.py").read()); print("syntax OK")' prints syntax OK
python -m etl4.bench.scale_study --dry-run prints 12-cell plan and exits 0 without touching parquet or Postgres
python -m etl4.bench.scale_study --volumes 1000 --methods time_gap runs end-to-end against real bronze, inserts one row verifiable via docker exec psql, prints status line
Skip-and-log path for (kinematic_smoothing, 50M) works with a fake prior row: NULL wall_secs/rows_per_sec/peak_rss_mb + notes='skipped: projected_peak_rss_mb>12000'
